company.name: Wisdom AI
company.shortDescription: WisdomAI develops an AI data analyst to answer questions from structured and unstructured data for business insights in the enterprise.
company.description: WisdomAI develops an AI data analyst to answer questions from structured and unstructured data for business insights in the enterprise. It is a data analytics platform that enables enterprise users to ask natural-language questions and receive answers from both structured and unstructured data sources—even when the data is messy or incomplete. It allows business leaders to quickly drill into insights, replacing the need for time-consuming analyst reports with real-time, accurate responses. The platform avoids hallucinations by using generative AI only to generate queries, not the answers themselves. Early adopters include companies across sectors like oil and gas, who use WisdomAI to query data from documents, telemetry, and databases.
